project.name: treetracker-tile-server
project.description: Greenstand Treetracker map tile server, forked from node-mapnik (the Node.js bindings to the Mapnik C++ rendering library). Its Express service in greenstand/ renders tree data from PostGIS into 256x256 PNG tiles and UTF grid JSON tiles, and the repo ships a Dockerfile, Kubernetes manifests, and GitHub Actions deployment workflows.

nodes.name: ds_emitter.hpp
nodes.summary: Header-only helpers that turn a mapnik datasource's layer descriptor into JS objects: a field name-to-type map (Number, String, Boolean) and a full description with type, encoding, geometry_type, and extra parameters.

nodes.name: get_fields
nodes.summary: Iterates the attribute descriptors of a datasource layer and sets each field name on a JS object with a type label such as "Number", "String", or "Boolean".

nodes.name: describe_datasource
nodes.summary: Fills a JS description object with the datasource type (raster or vector), encoding, field map, geometry_type (point, linestring, polygon, collection), and the descriptor's extra parameters.

nodes.name: js_grid_utils.hpp
nodes.summary: Header-only template helpers for UTFGrid output: they encode the feature ids of a mapnik grid as rows of UTF-8 characters with a key order, and collect the attributes of each key's feature into a JS object.
nodes.languageNotes: Function templates parameterized on the grid type T, so one implementation serves both mapnik grid and grid_view outputs.

nodes.name: grid2utf
nodes.summary: Walks a mapnik grid at a given resolution and writes each row as a UTF-8 line, giving each unique feature key one codepoint (from 32 upward, skipping the quote and backslash codepoints) and recording the key order.

nodes.name: write_features
nodes.summary: For each key in key_order, finds the grid feature and copies its requested attributes (plus __id__) into a JS object keyed by the feature key, converting values with value_converter.

nodes.name: mapnik_datasource.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Datasource N-API class: it builds a datasource from a key/value options object through mapnik's datasource_cache and exposes parameters, extent, describe, featureset, and fields to JavaScript.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the Datasource JS class with the parameters, describe, featureset, extent, and fields instance methods and stores its persistent constructor on the module exports.

nodes.name: Datasource
nodes.summary: Constructs a Datasource from an External datasource_ptr, or from a JS options object whose values become string mapnik::parameters for datasource_cache::create, then sets the JS type property to raster or vector.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Returns the parameters of the wrapped mapnik datasource as a plain JS object, converting each value with params_to_object.

nodes.name: extent
nodes.summary: Returns the datasource envelope as a [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] JS array and rethrows plugin errors (for example from the PostGIS plugin) as JS exceptions.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Returns a JS description of the datasource by delegating to describe_datasource, converting C++ exceptions into JS errors.

nodes.name: featureset
nodes.summary: Builds a mapnik::query over the datasource envelope or an optional options.extent box, requests all descriptor fields, and wraps the resulting featureset in a JS Featureset, or returns null when it is empty.

nodes.name: mapnik_datasource.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Datasource N-API wrapper class around a shared mapnik::datasource pointer, with friend access for Layer and the JS methods parameters, describe, featureset, extent, and fields.

nodes.name: Datasource
nodes.summary: N-API ObjectWrap class that holds a datasource_ptr and hands it to Layer through impl(); it declares the Initialize hook and five JS instance methods.

nodes.name: mapnik_expression.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Expression N-API class, which parses a mapnik filter expression string and evaluates it against a mapnik.Feature with optional bound variables.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the Expression JS class with the evaluate and toString methods and exports it under the name Expression.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: Parses the single string argument with mapnik::parse_expression into expression_ and throws a JS TypeError for a missing or non-string argument.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Checks that the first argument is a mapnik.Feature, reads optional options.variables into mapnik::attributes with object_to_container, evaluates the parsed expression, and returns the result converted by value_converter.

nodes.name: mapnik_expression.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Expression N-API wrapper class that holds a parsed mapnik::expression_ptr and exposes toString and evaluate to JavaScript.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class that stores a mapnik expression_ptr, with a static Initialize hook, a string constructor, and the toString and evaluate JS methods.

nodes.name: mapnik_feature.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Feature N-API class: creation from a numeric id, an External feature_ptr, or a GeoJSON string, plus the id, extent, attributes, geometry, and toJSON methods.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the Feature JS class with the id, extent, attributes, geometry, and toJSON instance methods and the static fromJSON factory.

nodes.name: Feature
nodes.summary: Wraps an existing feature_ptr passed as an External, or creates a new mapnik feature with a fresh context for a numeric id; for other arguments it throws a JS error.

nodes.name: fromJSON
nodes.summary: Static factory that parses a GeoJSON feature string with mapnik::json::from_geojson into a new feature and returns it as a JS Feature instance.

nodes.name: extent
nodes.summary: Returns the envelope of the wrapped mapnik feature as a four-number [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] JS array.

nodes.name: attributes
nodes.summary: Copies every attribute key/value of the wrapped feature into a JS object, converting mapnik values with value_converter.

nodes.name: toJSON
nodes.summary: Serializes the wrapped feature to a GeoJSON string with mapnik::util::to_geojson and throws a JS error when the conversion fails.

nodes.name: mapnik_feature.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Feature N-API wrapper class around a mapnik::feature_ptr and its context, with a public static constructor reference that other bindings use to create JS Feature objects.

nodes.name: Feature
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class that holds a mapnik feature_ptr and context_ptr; it exposes fromJSON, id, extent, attributes, geometry, and toJSON, plus impl() for C++ callers.

nodes.name: mapnik_featureset.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Featureset N-API iterator, which wraps a mapnik featureset_ptr and returns one JS Feature per next() call until the set is exhausted.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the Featureset JS class with its single next instance method and exports it as Featureset.

nodes.name: Featureset
nodes.summary: Accepts only an External featureset_ptr from an existing datasource or map query and throws a TypeError for direct construction from JavaScript.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Advances the wrapped featureset and returns the next feature as a JS Feature, or null when no feature remains, converting iterator exceptions into JS errors.

nodes.name: mapnik_featureset.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Featureset N-API iterator class over a mapnik featureset_ptr, with friend access for Datasource and the detail::AsyncQueryPoint worker.

nodes.name: Featureset
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap iterator class that stores a featureset_ptr and exposes one next method; Datasource and AsyncQueryPoint create instances through its constructor reference.

nodes.name: mapnik_fonts.hpp
nodes.summary: Header-only module-level font functions that wrap mapnik's freetype_engine: register a font directory (optionally recursive) and list registered face names, memory-cached fonts, and face-to-file mappings.

nodes.name: register_fonts
nodes.summary: Validates a font directory path and an optional { recurse } option, registers the fonts with mapnik::freetype_engine, and returns true when it found fonts.

nodes.name: available_font_faces
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of all font face names that are registered in the global mapnik freetype_engine.

nodes.name: memory_fonts
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of the font file keys held in the in-memory font cache of the freetype_engine.

nodes.name: available_font_files
nodes.summary: Returns a JS object that maps each registered font face name to its font file path from the freetype_engine mapping.

nodes.name: mapnik_geometry.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Geometry N-API class for the geometry of a feature: type, extent, WKT, WKB, and sync or async GeoJSON export, with optional reprojection through a ProjTransform.

nodes.name: AsyncToJSON
nodes.summary: Napi::AsyncWorker that serializes a Geometry to GeoJSON on a worker thread, reprojects it first when a ProjTransform is given, and passes the JSON string to the callback.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the Geometry JS class with the extent, type, toWKB, toWKT, toJSON, and toJSONSync methods and static geometry type constants from Unknown to GeometryCollection.

nodes.name: Geometry
nodes.summary: Wraps the feature_ptr passed as an External and throws a JS error for direct construction, because a Geometry exists only through a mapnik.Feature.

nodes.name: toJSONSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously returns the geometry as a GeoJSON string and, when options.transform is a ProjTransform, reprojects the geometry before serialization.

nodes.name: toJSON
nodes.summary: Falls back to toJSONSync when no callback is given; otherwise it validates the optional transform option and queues an AsyncToJSON worker.

nodes.name: extent
nodes.summary: Returns the bounding box of the parent feature envelope of the geometry as a [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] JS array.

nodes.name: toWKT
nodes.summary: Encodes the wrapped geometry as a Well-Known Text string with mapnik::util::to_wkt and throws when the encoding fails.

nodes.name: toWKB
nodes.summary: Encodes the geometry as little-endian (wkbNDR) Well-Known Binary and returns it as a copied Node Buffer, throwing when the geometry is null.

nodes.name: mapnik_geometry.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Geometry N-API wrapper class, which keeps the owning mapnik feature_ptr and reads its geometry for type, extent, WKB, WKT, and GeoJSON conversions.

nodes.name: Geometry
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class that stores a feature_ptr, gives Feature friend access, and returns the geometry of that feature through an inline geometry() accessor.

nodes.name: mapnik_layer.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Layer N-API class: construction from a name and optional srs, JS accessors for name, srs, styles, datasource, scale denominators, queryable, active, and clear_label_cache, and a describe method.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the Layer JS class with the describe method and nine getter/setter accessors and exports it as Layer.

nodes.name: Layer
nodes.summary: Wraps an External layer_ptr, or creates a new mapnik::layer from a name string and an optional srs string, and throws a TypeError for other argument shapes.

nodes.name: styles
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the style names of the layer: the getter returns them as a JS array and the setter appends each string of a JS array with add_style.

nodes.name: datasource
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the layer datasource: the getter wraps it as a JS Datasource (or null) and the setter accepts only a mapnik.Datasource instance.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Returns a JS object with the layer name, srs, active, clear_label_cache, scale denominators, queryable flag, style names, and datasource parameters.

nodes.name: mapnik_layer.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Layer N-API wrapper class around a shared mapnik::layer pointer, with Map as a friend and a getter/setter pair for each layer property.

nodes.name: Layer
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class that holds a layer_ptr and declares describe plus nine getter/setter accessor pairs; impl() hands the mapnik layer to Map.

nodes.name: mapnik_logger.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the static mapnik.Logger N-API class that reads and sets the severity of the global mapnik logger and exposes the NONE, ERROR, DEBUG, and WARN constants.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the Logger JS class with the static getSeverity and setSeverity methods and the NONE, ERROR, DEBUG, and WARN severity constants.

nodes.name: set_severity
nodes.summary: Validates one numeric argument and sets it as the severity of the global mapnik::logger singleton.

nodes.name: mapnik_logger.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Logger N-API class whose only members are static severity getters and setters, because mapnik.Logger cannot be instantiated.

nodes.name: Logger
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class with a static Initialize hook and static get_severity and set_severity methods; its constructor throws to prevent instances.

nodes.name: mapnik_map.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements most of the mapnik.Map N-API class: construction, accessors for srs, size, extents, buffer, background, parameters, and aspect_fix_mode, plus font, layer, clone, save, toXML, and zoom operations.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the Map JS class with its load, render, query, font, layer, and zoom methods and property accessors, and attaches the ASPECT_* aspect-fix-mode constants to the constructor.

nodes.name: Map
nodes.summary: Wraps an External map_ptr or creates a mapnik::Map from integer width and height plus an optional srs string, throwing for invalid arguments.

nodes.name: extent
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the current map extent: the getter returns [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] and the setter zooms the map to the given box.

nodes.name: maximumExtent
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the optional maximum extent: the getter returns undefined when it is unset, and the setter stores a new [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] box.

nodes.name: bufferedExtent
nodes.summary: Read-only accessor that returns the buffered extent of the map as a four-number array, or undefined when mapnik reports none.

nodes.name: aspect_fix_mode
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the aspect fix mode; the setter accepts only numbers from 0 up to aspect_fix_mode_MAX and throws for other values.

nodes.name: background
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the map background color: the getter wraps it as a JS Color and the setter requires a mapnik.Color instance.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Getter/setter pair for the extra parameters of the map; the setter converts JS strings, integers, doubles, and booleans into mapnik::parameters.

nodes.name: memoryFonts
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of the font keys held in the font memory cache that belongs to this map.

nodes.name: registerFonts
nodes.summary: Registers a font directory on this map only, with an optional { recurse } option, and returns whether mapnik found fonts there.

nodes.name: fonts
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of the font face names in the font file mapping of this map.

nodes.name: fontFiles
nodes.summary: Returns a JS object that maps each font face name of this map to its font file path.

nodes.name: fontDirectory
nodes.summary: Returns the registered font directory string of the map, or undefined when the map has none.

nodes.name: layers
nodes.summary: Copies every layer of the map into a new layer_ptr and returns them as an array of JS Layer objects.

nodes.name: add_layer
nodes.summary: Validates that the argument is a mapnik.Layer instance and appends a copy of its mapnik layer to the map.

nodes.name: remove_layer
nodes.summary: Removes the layer at a numeric index from the map and throws when the index is missing or out of range.

nodes.name: get_layer
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of one map layer as a JS Layer, found by numeric index or by layer name, and throws when no layer matches.

nodes.name: resize
nodes.summary: Validates two numeric arguments and resizes the map to the new width and height in pixels.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Copies the wrapped mapnik::Map into a new map_ptr and returns it as an independent JS Map instance.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Writes the map definition to an XML file at the given path with mapnik::save_map and returns true on success or false on failure.

nodes.name: toXML
nodes.summary: Serializes the map definition to an XML string with mapnik::save_map_to_string and throws when the export fails.

nodes.name: zoomAll
nodes.summary: Zooms the map to the combined extent of all its layers and turns mapnik exceptions into JS errors.

nodes.name: zoomToBox
nodes.summary: Zooms the map to a bounding box that is given as one [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] array or as four numeric arguments.

nodes.name: mapnik_map_query_point.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Map.queryPoint and Map.queryMapPoint, which validate x/y, an optional layer name or index, and a callback, then run an async worker that returns per-layer Featuresets at that point.

nodes.name: AsyncQueryPoint
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that queries one layer or all layers of a map at a point in geographic or map coordinates, then returns an array of { layer, featureset } JS objects.

nodes.name: query_point_impl
nodes.summary: Shared implementation of queryPoint and queryMapPoint: it validates the coordinates, resolves options.layer by name or zero-based index, checks the callback, and queues AsyncQueryPoint.

nodes.name: mapnik_plugins.hpp
nodes.summary: Header-only module-level functions for mapnik input plugins: list the plugin names in datasource_cache and register one .input plugin file or a directory of plugins.

nodes.name: available_input_plugins
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of the input plugin names that are registered in the mapnik datasource_cache singleton.

nodes.name: register_datasource
nodes.summary: Registers one mapnik input plugin file path (such as postgis.input) with datasource_cache and returns true when the plugin count grew.

nodes.name: register_datasources
nodes.summary: Registers every input plugin in a directory with datasource_cache and returns true when the plugin count grew.

nodes.name: mapnik_projection.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Projection and mapnik.ProjTransform N-API classes, which project [x, y] points and [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] boxes between WGS84 and a proj4 projection or between two projections.

nodes.name: Projection::Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the Projection JS class with the forward and inverse instance methods.

nodes.name: Projection
nodes.summary: Creates a mapnik::projection from a proj4 init string with an optional { lazy } flag and converts initialization failures into JS errors.

nodes.name: Projection::forward
nodes.summary: Projects a WGS84 [x, y] point, or the four corners of a [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] box, into this projection and returns the projected array.

nodes.name: inverse
nodes.summary: Unprojects an [x, y] point or the min and max corners of a box from this projection back to WGS84 coordinates.

nodes.name: ProjTransform::Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the ProjTransform JS class with the forward and backward instance methods.

nodes.name: ProjTransform
nodes.summary: Takes two mapnik.Projection instances (source and destination) and builds a shared mapnik::proj_transform between them.

nodes.name: ProjTransform::forward
nodes.summary: Transforms an [x, y] point or a box from the source to the destination projection and throws a message with both proj params when the transform fails.

nodes.name: backward
nodes.summary: Transforms an [x, y] point or a box from the destination back to the source projection and throws a descriptive JS error when mapnik fails.

nodes.name: mapnik_projection.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Projection and ProjTransform N-API wrapper classes around shared mapnik::projection and mapnik::proj_transform pointers.

nodes.name: Projection
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class that holds a proj_ptr, with forward and inverse methods; ProjTransform is a friend so that it can read the wrapped projection.

nodes.name: ProjTransform
nodes.summary: ObjectWrap class that holds a proj_tr_ptr with forward and backward methods, plus an impl() accessor that Geometry uses for reprojection.

nodes.name: mapnik_vector_tile_query.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements VectorTile.query and VectorTile.queryMany: they reproject lon/lat to web mercator, read layers from the PBF tile, and return features within a tolerance sorted by distance, synchronously or through async workers.

nodes.name: p2p_distance
nodes.summary: Geometry visitor that computes the distance and hit coordinates from a query point to points, line strings, polygons (with a point-in-polygon test), and their multi and collection variants.

nodes.name: _query
nodes.summary: Reprojects one lon/lat to EPSG:3857, scans the named layer or all layers of the tile with features_at_point, keeps features within tolerance, and sorts them by distance.

nodes.name: _queryResultToV8
nodes.summary: Converts query results into a JS array of Feature objects with the layer, distance, x_hit, and y_hit properties.

nodes.name: AsyncQuery
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that runs _query for one lon/lat on a worker thread and returns the converted feature array to the callback.

nodes.name: _queryManyResultToV8
nodes.summary: Builds the queryMany JS result: a features map from feature index to Feature with its layer, and a hits map from query point index to { distance, feature_id } lists.

nodes.name: _queryMany
nodes.summary: Reprojects many lon/lat points, queries one tile layer inside their padded bounding box with optional field filtering, and records per-point hits sorted by distance.

nodes.name: AsyncQueryMany
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that runs _queryMany for a set of points on a worker thread and passes the hits and features object to the callback.

nodes.name: query
nodes.summary: JS VectorTile.query entry point: it validates lon, lat, and the tolerance and layer options, then runs _query synchronously or queues AsyncQuery when a callback is given.

nodes.name: queryMany
nodes.summary: JS VectorTile.queryMany entry point: it converts the [[lon, lat], ...] array and the tolerance, layer, and fields options, requires a layer, and runs _queryMany sync or async.

nodes.name: node_mapnik.cpp
nodes.summary: N-API module entry point of the native mapnik binding: it registers plugin, font, cache, and blend functions, initializes every wrapper class, and exports enum constants, dependency versions, and a supports feature map.

nodes.name: init_image_comp_op
nodes.summary: Exports the compositeOp object that maps blend mode names such as src_over, multiply, and hue to mapnik composite operation constants.

nodes.name: init_image_types
nodes.summary: Exports the imageType object that maps pixel type names (null, rgba8, and gray8 through gray64f) to mapnik image dtype constants.

nodes.name: init_image_scalings
nodes.summary: Exports the imageScaling object that maps resampling filter names such as near, bilinear, and lanczos to mapnik scaling constants.

nodes.name: init_polygon_fill_types
nodes.summary: Exports the polygonFillType object with the evenOdd, nonZero, positive, and negative Clipper fill rules for vector tile encoding.

nodes.name: init_threading_mode_types
nodes.summary: Exports the threadingMode object that maps async, deferred, and auto to std::launch policy values.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Module init function registered with NODE_API_MODULE: it attaches module functions, calls Initialize on each wrapper class, adds enum tables, and builds the versions and supports objects.

nodes.name: utf8.hpp
nodes.summary: Vendored copy of the public-domain sheredom utf8.h library inside the node_mapnik namespace, with C-style UTF-8 functions for comparison, search, copy, validation, codepoint encode/decode, and case mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: A C library compiled as C++ inside a namespace and an extern "C" block; weak symbols and restrict macros let it live in a header without duplicate-symbol link errors.

nodes.name: utf8codepoint
nodes.summary: Decodes the next 1- to 4-byte UTF-8 sequence of a string into out_codepoint and returns a pointer to the byte after it.

nodes.name: utf8catcodepoint
nodes.summary: Encodes one codepoint as 1 to 4 UTF-8 bytes into a buffer with n bytes left and returns the next write position, or null when space is short; grid2utf uses it to build grid rows.

nodes.name: utf8valid
nodes.summary: Scans a UTF-8 string and returns a pointer to the first malformed or overlong sequence, or null when the whole string is valid.

nodes.name: utf8lwrcodepoint
nodes.summary: Maps an uppercase Latin, Greek, or Cyrillic codepoint to its lowercase form with range rules and a switch of special cases.

nodes.name: utf8uprcodepoint
nodes.summary: Maps a lowercase Latin, Greek, or Cyrillic codepoint to its uppercase form, mirroring the ranges and special cases of utf8lwrcodepoint.

nodes.name: utils.hpp
nodes.summary: Shared node_mapnik helpers: the value_converter visitor that turns mapnik values (integer, bool, double, string, unicode string, null) into Napi values, and params_to_object, which copies one parameter onto a JS object.

nodes.name: value_converter
nodes.summary: Visitor struct with operator() overloads that convert each mapnik value variant (integer, bool, double, std::string, ICU unicode string, null) into the matching Napi value.

nodes.name: params_to_object
nodes.summary: Sets one key on a JS object to a mapnik value_holder converted through value_converter; the datasource, layer, and map bindings use it to export parameters.

nodes.name: blend.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.blend N-API function, which decodes PNG/JPEG/WebP buffers or reuses rgba8 mapnik.Image objects, composites the layers with x/y offsets and optional HSL tint over a matte color, and re-encodes the canvas as PNG (full color, palette, octree or hextree), JPEG, or WebP on a worker thread. It also exposes the rgb2hsl and hsl2rgb color helpers to JavaScript.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Napi::AsyncWorker so decode, blend, and encode run on the libuv thread pool. HAVE_PNG, HAVE_JPEG, and HAVE_WEBP preprocessor guards compile each codec in or out. Layers are walked from top to bottom so that an opaque layer that covers the canvas stops the decoding of the layers below it.

nodes.name: hexToUInt32Color
nodes.summary: Parses a '#rrggbb' or '#rrggbbaa' matte string into a packed 32-bit pixel value in 0xAABBGGRR order (little-endian RGBA bytes), and rejects strings shorter than six characters or with a wrong digit count.

nodes.name: rgb2hsl
nodes.summary: JavaScript-exposed helper that requires three numeric r, g, b arguments and returns a three-element [h, s, l] array computed by rgb_to_hsl.

nodes.name: hsl2rgb
nodes.summary: JavaScript-exposed helper that requires three fractional h, s, l arguments and returns an [r, g, b] integer array computed by hsl_to_rgb.

nodes.name: parseTintOps
nodes.summary: Reads the optional h, s, l, and a two-element arrays of a JS tint object into the range fields of a Tinter, and throws a TypeError when an array is not a pair (the l branch throws but does not return false).

nodes.name: Blend_CompositePixel
nodes.summary: Composites one 32-bit source pixel over a target pixel in place: it skips a fully transparent source, copies an opaque source or a source over a transparent target, and otherwise applies integer source-over alpha blending.

nodes.name: TintPixel
nodes.summary: Converts an r, g, b triple to HSL, remaps each channel linearly into the Tinter ranges [h0,h1], [s0,s1], [l0,l1] with clamping to 0-1, and converts the result back to RGB in place.

nodes.name: Blend_Composite
nodes.summary: Blends one decoded BImage layer onto the target canvas at the x/y offset of the layer, clips to the canvas bounds, and for a non-identity tint or alpha range rescales alpha and tints each pixel before it calls Blend_CompositePixel.

nodes.name: AsyncBlend
nodes.summary: Napi::AsyncWorker that carries the blend inputs (layer list, quality, width, height, palette, matte, compression, alpha mode, output format, reencode flag) and produces the encoded output buffer off the main thread.

nodes.name: AsyncBlend::AsyncBlend
nodes.summary: Constructor of the blend worker that passes the JS callback to the AsyncWorker base and stores the ten blend parameters, from the Images list to the reencode flag, in its fields.

nodes.name: AsyncBlend::Execute
nodes.summary: Worker-thread body that walks the layers from top to bottom, decodes each buffer with a mapnik image_reader or reuses an rgba8 Image, drops layers outside the viewport, takes the canvas size from the first visible layer when none is given, returns the original bytes for a single opaque unchanged layer, and stops decoding below an opaque full-cover layer; it then fills the matte, composites every layer, and calls Blend_Encode.

nodes.name: AsyncBlend::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, Buffer) to the blend callback by giving the encoded std::string to a Napi::Buffer whose finalizer deletes the string and reverses the V8 external memory adjustment.

nodes.name: Blend_Encode
nodes.summary: Encodes the blended rgba8 canvas into the worker output buffer as JPEG (default quality 85), WebP (default quality 80, compression used as the method), or PNG, where PNG uses a given mapnik.Palette, octree or hextree quantization when quality is set, or full color otherwise.

nodes.name: blend
nodes.summary: Entry point for mapnik.blend(buffers, [options], callback): it validates format, quality ranges, reencode, width, height, matte, palette, mode, and compression limits, passes a single Buffer straight to the callback when no reencode is needed, converts each array element (Buffer, rgba8 mapnik.Image, or {buffer, x, y, tint} object) into a BImage, and queues an AsyncBlend worker.

nodes.name: blend.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the node_mapnik blend types: the BImage layer record, the ImagePtr and Images aliases, the BlendFormat (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and AlphaMode (octree, hextree) enums, and the rgb2hsl, hsl2rgb, and blend N-API entry points that node_mapnik.cpp registers.

nodes.name: BImage
nodes.summary: Per-layer input record for blend that holds a persistent reference to the source Buffer with its data pointer and length, the x/y placement, the decoded width and height, a Tinter, an owned decoded image_rgba8, a raw pixel pointer, and an optional shared mapnik.Image.

nodes.name: BImage::BImage
nodes.summary: Default constructor of a blend layer that sets offsets, sizes, and the data length to zero, sets the data and image pointers to null, and starts with an identity Tinter.

nodes.name: mapnik_color.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Color JavaScript class: it registers the hex and toString methods and the r, g, b, a, and premultiplied accessors, and builds a mapnik::color from a CSS color string, an internal External, or numeric r, g, b[, a] values with 0-255 range checks and an optional premultiplied flag.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the JS Color class with the hex and toString methods and the r, g, b, a, and premultiplied accessors, keeps the constructor in a persistent reference, and sets Color on the module exports.

nodes.name: Color
nodes.summary: Color constructor that accepts an External mapnik::color, a CSS color string with an optional premultiplied boolean, or three to five numeric r, g, b, a arguments with an optional premultiplied boolean, and throws a TypeError for out-of-range channels or other argument shapes.

nodes.name: red
nodes.summary: Getter and setter pair behind the JS r property: the getter returns the red channel, and the setter checks for an integer in 0-255 before it calls set_red.

nodes.name: green
nodes.summary: Getter and setter pair behind the JS g property that reads the green channel, or range-checks a 0-255 integer and stores it with set_green.

nodes.name: blue
nodes.summary: Implements the JS b property: the getter returns color_.blue(), and the setter rejects non-numbers and values outside 0-255 before it calls set_blue.

nodes.name: alpha
nodes.summary: Accessor pair for the JS a property that exposes the alpha channel and validates written values against the 0-255 range before set_alpha.

nodes.name: mapnik_color.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Color Napi::ObjectWrap class that wraps a mapnik::color value, with an Initialize registrar, a constructor, toString and hex methods, and getter/setter pairs for red, green, blue, alpha, and premultiplied.

nodes.name: Color
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class that JavaScript sees as mapnik.Color; it wraps one mapnik::color value and gives Image, ImageView, and Map friend access to that value.

nodes.name: mapnik_image.cpp
nodes.summary: Core implementation of the mapnik.Image JavaScript class: Initialize binds 2 accessors, 33 instance methods, and 9 static factories (the mapnik_image_*.cpp files implement most of them), and this file implements the constructor plus getType, getPixel, setPixel, compare, setGrayScaleToAlpha, premultiplied, painted, width, height, view, offset, scaling, data, and buffer.
nodes.languageNotes: The Image class is split across many translation units: mapnik_image.hpp declares every method, and each mapnik_image_*.cpp file defines one feature group. An External<image_ptr> constructor argument lets C++ code wrap an existing shared image without a copy.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the JS Image class with the offset and scaling accessors, 33 instance methods, and the 9 static factories openSync, open, fromBufferSync, fromBytesSync, fromBytes, fromSVGSync, fromSVG, fromSVGBytesSync, and fromSVGBytes, and publishes it as exports.Image.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: Image constructor that either adopts an External image_ptr (used by workers and factories) or allocates a mapnik::image_any of the given width and height, after it validates the type (a mapnik.imageType), initialize, premultiplied, and painted options.

nodes.name: getPixel
nodes.summary: Returns the pixel at (x, y) as a raw number through visitor_get_pixel, or as a new mapnik.Color object when options.get_color is true; coordinates outside the image return undefined.

nodes.name: setPixel
nodes.summary: Writes the pixel at (x, y) from a number through visitor_set_pixel or from a mapnik.Color, and throws a TypeError for coordinates outside the image or for other value types.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Counts the pixels that differ between this image and another mapnik.Image of equal size with mapnik::compare, with an optional per-channel threshold and an alpha flag.

nodes.name: setGrayScaleToAlpha
nodes.summary: Moves the grayscale intensity of the image into its alpha channel with mapnik::set_grayscale_to_alpha, optionally with a mapnik.Color as the base RGB, which creates mask layers.

nodes.name: view
nodes.summary: Creates a mapnik.ImageView over the x, y, width, height rectangle of this image by passing the image_ptr as an External to the ImageView constructor.

nodes.name: offset
nodes.summary: Getter and setter for the JS offset property, which reads or writes the numeric offset that mapnik stores on the image_any for raster value transforms; the setter throws when the value is not a number.

nodes.name: scaling
nodes.summary: Getter and setter for the JS scaling property of the underlying image_any; the setter rejects non-numbers and the value zero.

nodes.name: mapnik_image.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Image Napi::ObjectWrap class and the image_ptr alias (shared_ptr to mapnik::image_any), and lists every JS-facing method: pixel access, encode and save, open, fromBytes, fromBuffer, and fromSVG factories, composite, filter, fill, premultiply and demultiply, clear, compare, isSolid, copy, resize, and the scaling and offset accessors.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class that JavaScript sees as mapnik.Image; it owns an image_ptr to a mapnik::image_any and declares the full JS method set, the impl() accessor that blend and render code use, and the private encode_common_args_ and from_svg_sync_impl helpers.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_clear.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.clearSync and Image.clear, which set every pixel of the wrapped image to 0 (fully transparent) either inline or through the AsyncClear worker, which returns the same image to the callback.

nodes.name: AsyncClear
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that fills the shared image with 0 on the thread pool and passes a new JS Image that wraps the same image_ptr to the callback.

nodes.name: AsyncClear::GetResult
nodes.summary: Wraps the cleared image_ptr in a new mapnik.Image through an External and returns (null, image) to the clear callback.

nodes.name: clearSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously sets every pixel to 0 with mapnik::fill and turns any std::exception into a JS Error.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Calls clearSync when there are no arguments; otherwise it checks that the last argument is a function and queues an AsyncClear worker.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_compositing.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.composite, which requires both images to be premultiplied, parses comp_op, opacity, dx, dy, and an image_filters string, and runs the AsyncComposite worker to filter the source and blend it onto this image with mapnik::composite.

nodes.name: AsyncComposite
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that holds the source and destination images, the composite mode, the dx/dy offset, the opacity, and the parsed filter list for Image.composite, and returns the destination image.

nodes.name: AsyncComposite::AsyncComposite
nodes.summary: Constructor of the composite worker that stores the source and destination image_ptr, the composite_mode_e, the dx/dy pixel offsets, the opacity, and a copy of the parsed filter vector.

nodes.name: AsyncComposite::Execute
nodes.summary: Runs the parsed image filters on the source image with filter_visitor and premultiplies its alpha again, then composites the source onto the destination with mapnik::composite at the given mode, opacity, and offset.

nodes.name: composite
nodes.summary: JS Image.composite(image, [options], callback): it requires a premultiplied mapnik.Image source and a premultiplied destination, validates comp_op (up to divide), opacity in 0-1, integer dx and dy, and an image_filters string parsed by parse_image_filters, and queues AsyncComposite.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_copy.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.copy and Image.copySync, which clone the image into a new mapnik.Image of a requested image type with optional scaling and offset through mapnik::image_copy; the async form runs the AsyncCopy worker.

nodes.name: AsyncCopy
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker for Image.copy that converts the input image to a target image_dtype with an offset and a scaling value and returns the new image.

nodes.name: AsyncCopy::Execute
nodes.summary: Calls mapnik::image_copy with the target type, offset, and scaling, stores the result as a new shared image_any, and records any exception as the worker error.

nodes.name: AsyncCopy::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (undefined, image) to the copy callback, where image is a new mapnik.Image that wraps the copied image_out_ pointer.

nodes.name: copy
nodes.summary: Async Image.copy([type], [options], callback): it calls copySync when the last argument is not a function, validates the image type and the scaling and offset options, keeps the source scaling and offset when the type is the same and none are given, and queues AsyncCopy.

nodes.name: copySync
nodes.summary: Synchronous Image.copySync([type], [options]) that applies the same type, scaling, and offset rules as copy and returns a new mapnik.Image built by mapnik::image_copy.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_encode.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.encodeSync and Image.encode, which serialize the image with mapnik save_to_string in a format such as png, optionally with a mapnik.Palette, and give the bytes to JavaScript as an externally owned Buffer; encode_common_args_ parses the shared arguments.

nodes.name: encode_common_args_
nodes.summary: Shared argument parser for Image.encode and Image.encodeSync that reads the optional format string and an options.palette that must be a mapnik.Palette instance into the format and palette_ptr references of the caller.

nodes.name: AsyncEncode
nodes.summary: Anonymous-namespace AsyncWorker that encodes an image_ptr to a std::string in the requested format, with an optional rgba_palette, and returns the bytes as a Buffer.

nodes.name: AsyncEncode::Execute
nodes.summary: Calls mapnik save_to_string on the full image with the format and, when present, the palette, and keeps the encoded bytes in result_.

nodes.name: AsyncEncode::GetResult
nodes.summary: Moves the encoded image string into a zero-copy Napi::Buffer whose finalizer deletes it, adds its size to V8 external memory, and returns (null, buffer) to the encode callback.

nodes.name: encodeSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously encodes the image (default format png) with save_to_string, optionally with a palette, and returns the bytes as an externally owned Buffer that AdjustExternalMemory tracks.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Parses the format and palette with encode_common_args_, requires a callback as the last argument, and queues an AsyncEncode worker for the image.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_fill.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.fillSync and Image.fill, which set all pixels to a numeric value or to a mapnik.Color; the async form uses the AsyncFill template worker for double or mapnik::color values.

nodes.name: AsyncFill
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker template (T is double or mapnik::color) that fills every pixel of the image with the stored value on the thread pool.

nodes.name: AsyncFill::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, image) to the fill callback, where image is a new JS Image that wraps the filled image_ptr.

nodes.name: fillSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously fills the image with a numeric value through mapnik::fill<double> or with a mapnik.Color, and throws a TypeError for other argument types.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Calls fillSync when there are fewer than two arguments; otherwise it validates the callback and queues AsyncFill<double> for a number or AsyncFill<mapnik::color> for a mapnik.Color.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_filter.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.filterSync and Image.filter, which apply a mapnik image filter expression such as blur, emboss, sharpen, sobel, or gray to the pixels in place, with the AsyncFilter worker for the callback form.

nodes.name: AsyncFilter
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that applies a stored filter string to the image with mapnik::filter::filter_image and returns the same image.

nodes.name: AsyncFilter::Execute
nodes.summary: Runs mapnik::filter::filter_image with the filter string on the worker thread and converts a thrown exception into the worker error.

nodes.name: AsyncFilter::GetResult
nodes.summary: Gives the filter callback (null, image) with a new mapnik.Image wrapper around the filtered image_ptr.

nodes.name: filterSync
nodes.summary: Requires a filter name string, applies it in place with mapnik::filter::filter_image, and throws a JS Error on failure.

nodes.name: filter
nodes.summary: Uses filterSync for fewer than two arguments; otherwise it validates the last-argument callback and the filter string and queues AsyncFilter.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_from_bytes.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the static Image.fromBytesSync, Image.fromBytes, and Image.fromBufferSync factories, which decode an encoded image Buffer through mapnik::get_image_reader (the async form enforces max_size and an optional premultiply) or wrap a raw RGBA Buffer of width*height*4 bytes as an rgba8 image.

nodes.name: AsyncFromBytes
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that keeps a persistent reference to the input Buffer while it decodes the bytes into an image_any on the thread pool, with a max_size limit and an optional premultiply step.

nodes.name: AsyncFromBytes::Execute
nodes.summary: Creates a mapnik image_reader from the buffer bytes, fails when a dimension is larger than max_size, reads the full image, and premultiplies it when requested.

nodes.name: AsyncFromBytes::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, image) with a new mapnik.Image around the decoded image when decoding succeeded, otherwise the default AsyncWorker error result.

nodes.name: fromBytesSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously decodes an encoded image Buffer with mapnik::get_image_reader and returns a new mapnik.Image, and marks images without alpha as premultiplied.

nodes.name: fromBytes
nodes.summary: Static Image.fromBytes(buffer, [options], callback): it uses fromBytesSync for one argument, validates the Buffer and the callback, reads premultiply (boolean) and max_size (0-65535, default 2048), and queues AsyncFromBytes.

nodes.name: fromBufferSync
nodes.summary: Builds an rgba8 mapnik.Image over a raw RGBA Buffer that must be exactly width*height*4 bytes, applies the premultiplied and painted options (rejects type), and attaches the Buffer to the result as _buffer because the buffer must outlive the image.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_from_svg.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the static Image.fromSVG, fromSVGSync, fromSVGBytes, and fromSVGBytesSync factories, which parse an SVG file or Buffer with the mapnik svg_parser, rasterize it with AGG at a given scale within a max_size limit, and return a demultiplied rgba8 mapnik.Image; strict mode turns parser messages into errors.
nodes.languageNotes: The SVG parse and AGG render pipeline (svg_path_adapter, svg_converter, renderer_agg on a premultiplied rgba32 pixel format) appears three times: in both workers and in from_svg_sync_impl.

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVG
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker for Image.fromSVG that parses an SVG file by name and rasterizes it into an image_any with the given scale, max_size, and strict settings.

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVG::Execute
nodes.summary: Parses the SVG file, fails in strict mode when the parser reports errors, rejects a zero or too large scaled size, renders the paths centered and scaled with the AGG SVG renderer into a premultiplied rgba8 image, and demultiplies the result.

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVG::GetResult
nodes.summary: Gives the image rasterized from an SVG file back to the fromSVG callback as (null, mapnik.Image).

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVGBytes
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker for Image.fromSVGBytes that holds a persistent reference to the SVG Buffer and rasterizes its contents with the same scale, max_size, and strict rules as the file-based worker.

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVGBytes::AsyncFromSVGBytes
nodes.summary: Constructor that pins the SVG Buffer with a persistent reference, caches its data pointer and length, and stores the scale, max_size, and strict values.

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVGBytes::Execute
nodes.summary: Copies the Buffer into a std::string, parses it with svg_parser::parse_from_string, applies the strict, zero-size, and max_size checks, and rasterizes it with AGG into a demultiplied rgba8 image.

nodes.name: AsyncFromSVGBytes::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns the image rasterized from SVG bytes to the fromSVGBytes callback as a new mapnik.Image wrapper.

nodes.name: from_svg_sync_impl
nodes.summary: Shared synchronous SVG loader behind fromSVGSync, fromSVGBytesSync, and the short form of fromSVGBytes: it validates a filename or Buffer and the scale, max_size, and strict options, parses and rasterizes the SVG with AGG into a size rounded to whole pixels, and returns a new mapnik.Image.

nodes.name: fromSVG
nodes.summary: Static Image.fromSVG(filename, [options], callback): it uses fromSVGSync for fewer than two arguments, validates the filename, the callback, and the scale, max_size, and strict options, and queues AsyncFromSVG.

nodes.name: fromSVGBytes
nodes.summary: Static Image.fromSVGBytes(buffer, [options], callback): it uses the synchronous loader for fewer than two arguments, validates the Buffer, the callback, and the options, and queues AsyncFromSVGBytes.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_multiply.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.premultiplySync, premultiply, demultiplySync, and demultiply, which convert the alpha representation of the image with mapnik premultiply_alpha or demultiply_alpha and use the AsyncMultiply<bool> template worker for the callback forms.

nodes.name: AsyncMultiply
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker template with a bool parameter that premultiplies (true) or demultiplies (false) the image alpha on the thread pool; the AsyncPremultiply and AsyncDemultiply aliases select each mode.

nodes.name: AsyncMultiply::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, image) to the premultiply or demultiply callback with a new mapnik.Image that wraps the converted image_ptr.

nodes.name: premultiply
nodes.summary: Runs premultiplySync when there are no arguments; otherwise it requires a last-argument callback and queues an AsyncPremultiply worker.

nodes.name: demultiply
nodes.summary: Runs demultiplySync when there are no arguments; otherwise it requires a last-argument callback and queues an AsyncDemultiply worker that reverses premultiplied alpha.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_open.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the static Image.openSync and Image.open factories, which detect the image type from the file name extension, read the file with a mapnik image_reader, and mark images without alpha as premultiplied.

nodes.name: AsyncOpen
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker that loads an image file by path on the thread pool and returns it as a mapnik.Image.

nodes.name: AsyncOpen::Execute
nodes.summary: Gets the image type from the file name, creates a mapnik image_reader, reads the whole image, and marks it premultiplied when the source has no alpha; it reports errors for an unknown type or a missing reader.

nodes.name: AsyncOpen::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, image) to the open callback with the image loaded from the file wrapped in a new mapnik.Image.

nodes.name: openSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously opens an image file by path, uses the file extension to choose a mapnik image_reader, and returns a new mapnik.Image or throws 'Unsupported image format'.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Static Image.open(path, callback): it calls openSync for a single argument, validates the path string and the callback, and queues AsyncOpen.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_resize.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.resize and Image.resizeSync, which create a new image of the requested width and height and scale a source window (offset_x, offset_y, offset_width, offset_height) into it with mapnik::scale_image_agg, a scaling_method, and a filter_factor; resize_visitor dispatches on the pixel type.

nodes.name: resize_visitor
nodes.summary: Anonymous-namespace visitor over the output image_any variant that scales the source into each supported pixel type with mapnik::scale_image_agg and throws for null, gray8s, gray16s, gray32, gray32s, gray64, gray64s, and gray64f rasters.

nodes.name: resize_visitor::resize_visitor
nodes.summary: Constructor that stores a reference to the source image_any plus the scaling method, the x/y ratios, the filter factor, and the x/y offsets (kept in int fields, so fractional offsets are truncated).

nodes.name: resize_visitor::operator()(image_rgba8&)
nodes.summary: Overload for an rgba8 output that premultiplies a non-premultiplied source in place before scale_image_agg and demultiplies the output afterward, so the scaling filter works on premultiplied color.

nodes.name: resize_visitor::operator()(T&)
nodes.summary: Generic overload for the other supported pixel types that calls scale_image_agg directly with the source of the same type, the ratios, the offsets, and the filter factor.

nodes.name: AsyncResize
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker for Image.resize that holds the input image, the scaling method, the target width and height, the source window offsets and size, and the filter factor, and produces a new resized image.

nodes.name: AsyncResize::AsyncResize
nodes.summary: Constructor that captures the source image_ptr, the scaling_method_e, the target size, the offset_x, offset_y, offset_width, and offset_height source window, and the filter factor.

nodes.name: AsyncResize::Execute
nodes.summary: Rejects null images, allocates an output image_any of the target size with the source dtype, offset, and scaling, computes the x/y ratios and corrected offsets from the source window, and applies resize_visitor.

nodes.name: AsyncResize::GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, image) to the resize callback with the new resized image wrapped as a mapnik.Image.

nodes.name: resize
nodes.summary: Async Image.resize(width, height, [options], callback): it calls resizeSync when there is no callback, validates a positive width and height, offset_x, offset_y, offset_width, offset_height, scaling_method (up to SCALING_BLACKMAN), and filter_factor, and queues AsyncResize.

nodes.name: resizeSync
nodes.summary: Synchronous Image.resizeSync that applies the same argument checks as resize, rejects null images and a non-positive source window, runs resize_visitor into a new image, and returns that image as a mapnik.Image.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_save.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.saveSync and Image.save, which write the encoded image to a file path with mapnik::save_to_file, take the format from the second argument or guess it from the file extension, and use the AsyncSave worker for the callback form.

nodes.name: AsyncSave
nodes.summary: Anonymous-namespace AsyncWorker that writes the image to a file name in a given format with mapnik::save_to_file and reports only errors to the callback.

nodes.name: AsyncSave::Execute
nodes.summary: Calls mapnik::save_to_file with the stored file name and format on the worker thread and records an exception as the worker error.

nodes.name: saveSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously saves the image to a file, takes the format from the second argument or from mapnik::guess_type on the file extension, and throws for an unknown extension.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Validates the file name, calls saveSync when the last argument is not a function, resolves the format from the arguments or the extension, and queues AsyncSave.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_solid.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Image.isSolid and Image.isSolidSync, which report with mapnik::is_solid whether every pixel in the image has the same value; the async AsyncIsSolid worker also returns the value of pixel (0,0) when the image is solid.

nodes.name: AsyncIsSolid
nodes.summary: Anonymous-namespace AsyncWorker that checks with mapnik::is_solid whether all pixels of an image are equal and, when they are, adds the value of pixel (0,0) to the callback arguments.

nodes.name: AsyncIsSolid::Execute
nodes.summary: Computes mapnik::is_solid for an image with positive width and height, or sets the error 'image does not have valid dimensions'.

nodes.name: isSolid
nodes.summary: Image.isSolid([callback]): it runs isSolidSync when there are no arguments, otherwise it validates the callback and queues AsyncIsSolid.

nodes.name: isSolidSync
nodes.summary: Returns a boolean from mapnik::is_solid for an image with valid dimensions and throws a JS Error for an empty image.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_view.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.ImageView JavaScript class, a read-only rectangular window over a parent mapnik.Image that Image.view creates; it registers width, height, encodeSync, encode, saveSync, isSolid, isSolidSync, and getPixel and implements them on mapnik::image_view_any with local AsyncIsSolid and AsyncEncode workers.
nodes.languageNotes: ImageView::encodeSync serializes *image_ (the full parent image), but the async AsyncEncode worker serializes *image_view_, so encodeSync and encode can return different bytes for a partial view.

nodes.name: AsyncIsSolid
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker for ImageView.isSolid that tests whether all pixels in the view are equal and appends the pixel at (0,0) of the view to the callback result when they are.

nodes.name: AsyncIsSolid::Execute
nodes.summary: Runs mapnik::is_solid on the image_view_any when the view has positive dimensions, or fails with 'image_view does not have valid dimensions'.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the JS ImageView class with width, height, encodeSync, encode, saveSync, isSolidSync, isSolid, and getPixel, keeps a persistent constructor reference, and adds ImageView to the exports.

nodes.name: ImageView
nodes.summary: ImageView constructor that only accepts the internal (External image_ptr, x, y, w, h) call from Image.view, keeps the parent image alive, and creates the view with mapnik::create_view; a direct JS construction throws an Error.

nodes.name: isSolid
nodes.summary: ImageView.isSolid([callback]): it calls isSolidSync when there are no arguments, otherwise it checks the callback and queues the view AsyncIsSolid worker.

nodes.name: isSolidSync
nodes.summary: Returns whether every pixel in the view is equal through mapnik::is_solid, and throws a TypeError when the view has zero width or height.

nodes.name: getPixel
nodes.summary: Reads the pixel at (x, y) inside the view as a number through visitor_get_pixel<image_view_any>, or as a new mapnik.Color with options.get_color; coordinates outside the view return undefined.

nodes.name: encode_common_args_
nodes.summary: Parses the optional format string and an options.palette that must be a mapnik.Palette for ImageView.encode and ImageView.encodeSync.

nodes.name: AsyncEncode
nodes.summary: AsyncWorker for ImageView.encode that serializes the view region with save_to_string in the requested format and with an optional palette.

nodes.name: AsyncEncode::Execute
nodes.summary: Encodes the image_view_any (not the parent image) to a std::string, with the palette overload of save_to_string when a palette is given.

nodes.name: AsyncEncode::GetResult
nodes.summary: Passes the encoded view bytes to the ImageView.encode callback as a Napi::Buffer that takes ownership of the string and keeps the V8 external-memory count balanced.

nodes.name: encodeSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously encodes to a Buffer with save_to_string in the chosen format and palette; it passes the parent image_ instead of the view, so it returns the encoded full parent image.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Parses the format and palette, requires a last-argument callback, and queues the view AsyncEncode worker, which encodes only the view region.

nodes.name: saveSync
nodes.summary: Saves the view region to a file with mapnik::save_to_file, with the explicit format argument or the type that mapnik::guess_type gets from the file extension.

nodes.name: mapnik_image_view.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the ImageView Napi::ObjectWrap class and the image_view_ptr alias (shared_ptr to mapnik::image_view_any); the class also keeps an image_ptr to the parent image to keep it alive and lists the encode, save, size, isSolid, and getPixel methods.
nodes.languageNotes: The header uses image_ptr and palette_ptr without an include of mapnik_image.hpp or mapnik_palette.hpp, so it compiles only when those headers are included before it.

nodes.name: ImageView
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class that JavaScript sees as mapnik.ImageView; it stores the image_view_ptr of the window and the parent image_ptr, and Image is a friend so Image.view can use its constructor reference.

nodes.name: mapnik_palette.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the mapnik.Palette JavaScript class, which builds a mapnik::rgba_palette from a Buffer in rgba, rgb, or act format and exposes toString (a '[Palette N colors #rrggbbaa ...]' summary) and toBuffer (raw RGBA bytes).

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the JS Palette class with the toBuffer and toString methods, keeps the constructor reference, and adds Palette to the module exports.

nodes.name: Palette
nodes.summary: Palette constructor that reads a palette Buffer and an optional type string (rgba, rgb, or act), throws for an empty buffer or an unknown type, and builds a shared mapnik::rgba_palette.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Formats the palette as '[Palette N colors #rrggbb[aa] ...]' and appends the alpha byte for entries that the alpha table covers, with a MAPNIK_VERSION switch between alpha_table() and alphaTable().

nodes.name: toBuffer
nodes.summary: Serializes the palette into a Buffer of 4 bytes per color (r, g, b, and alpha from the alpha table or 0xFF) through a 1024-byte stack array for up to 256 colors.

nodes.name: mapnik_palette.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Palette Napi::ObjectWrap class and the palette_ptr alias (shared_ptr to mapnik::rgba_palette) that Image, ImageView, Map, and blend use for paletted PNG encoding.

nodes.name: Palette
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class that JavaScript sees as mapnik.Palette; it owns a palette_ptr, offers toString and toBuffer, and has an inline palette() accessor that blend uses to read the native palette.

nodes.name: pixel_utils.hpp
nodes.summary: Provides pixel visitor templates in namespace detail: visitor_get_pixel reads the pixel at (x, y) from any mapnik image or image view variant and returns it as a JS Number, and visitor_set_pixel writes a JS Number into a pixel of an image variant.
nodes.languageNotes: A traits::null_image specialization maps image_any to image_null and image_view_any to image_view_null, so one visitor template can handle the null alternative of both variant types.

nodes.name: visitor_get_pixel
nodes.summary: Visitor template over image_any or image_view_any that returns the pixel value at (x, y) as a Napi::Number for each typed image and undefined for the null image type that traits::null_image selects.

nodes.name: visitor_set_pixel
nodes.summary: Visitor that writes a JS Number value (as a double) into pixel (x, y) of each non-null image_any alternative with mapnik::set_pixel and does nothing for image_null.

nodes.name: tint.hpp
nodes.summary: Header-only color math for blend tinting: static inline rgb_to_hsl, hueToRGB, and hsl_to_rgb conversions, plus the Tinter struct that stores [min, max] ranges for hue, saturation, lightness, and alpha and reports whether they are identity ranges.

nodes.name: rgb_to_hsl
nodes.summary: Converts 0-255 red, green, and blue integers to hue, saturation, and lightness fractions in 0-1 and writes them through output references.

nodes.name: hueToRGB
nodes.summary: HSL helper that maps a hue position and the m1/m2 intermediate values to one RGB channel fraction, and wraps the hue into the 0-1 range.

nodes.name: hsl_to_rgb
nodes.summary: Converts hue, saturation, and lightness fractions back to 0-255 red, green, and blue integers; it returns gray when saturation is zero and otherwise samples hueToRGB at h+1/3, h, and h-1/3.

nodes.name: Tinter
nodes.summary: Struct with the h0/h1, s0/s1, l0/l1, and a0/a1 range endpoints (default 0 and 1) that blend uses to remap layer colors, plus is_identity and is_alpha_identity checks that let blend skip the tint work.

nodes.name: mapnik_cairo_surface.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the N-API CairoSurface class: it registers the JS constructor with width, height, and getData methods, validates the (format, width, height) constructor arguments, and returns the captured Cairo or SVG output as a string.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Defines the JavaScript CairoSurface class with width, height, and getData instance methods, stores a persistent constructor reference, and sets the class on the module exports object.

nodes.name: CairoSurface
nodes.summary: CairoSurface constructor that requires exactly three JS arguments (format string, integer width, integer height) and throws a TypeError or Error when the count or a type is wrong.

nodes.name: mapnik_cairo_surface.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the CairoSurface N-API wrapper that holds a format, width, height, and std::stringstream buffer, plus a static Cairo write callback that appends rendered bytes to that stream; a stub compiles when HAVE_CAIRO is not defined.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a preprocessor fallback (#define cairo_status_t int) so that the header still compiles in builds without Cairo.

nodes.name: CairoSurface
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class for an in-memory vector output surface; VectorTile.render writes Cairo or native SVG output into its stringstream, and flush/set_data copy the bytes into the data string that getData returns.

nodes.name: write_callback
nodes.summary: Static cairo_write_func_t callback that casts the closure pointer back to a std::stringstream and appends each chunk of Cairo output bytes; it returns CAIRO_STATUS_WRITE_ERROR for a null stream or when Cairo support is absent.

nodes.name: mapnik_grid.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Grid N-API wrapper around a shared mapnik::grid (UTF grid hit buffer), compiled only when GRID_RENDERER is defined, with encode, addField, fields, view, painted, clear, and key accessor methods.

nodes.name: Grid
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class that exposes a mapnik::grid through grid_ptr to JavaScript; Map.render and VectorTile.render accept it as a render target and read its field names and join key to fill UTF grid data.

nodes.name: mapnik_map.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the Map N-API wrapper around std::shared_ptr<mapnik::Map>, with the JS methods for stylesheet loading, sync and async rendering, layer management, point queries, and property accessors, plus an atomic in-use flag.

nodes.name: Map
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class for a Mapnik map; acquire() and release() use an atomic flag so that only one render runs on a Map at a time, and the class grants friend access to AsyncMapLoad, AsyncMapFromString, and VectorTile.

nodes.name: mapnik_map_from_string.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Map.fromStringSync and Map.fromString, which parse a Mapnik XML stylesheet given as a string (with optional strict and base path options) into the wrapped mapnik::Map; the async form runs on a worker thread.

nodes.name: AsyncMapFromString
nodes.summary: Napi::AsyncWorker that holds a map_ptr, the stylesheet XML string, the base path, and the strict flag, loads the stylesheet off the main thread, and then calls back with a new Map wrapper.

nodes.name: AsyncMapFromString.Execute
nodes.summary: Worker-thread step that calls mapnik::load_map_string on the shared map and converts any std::exception into the worker error that the JS callback receives.

nodes.name: AsyncMapFromString.GetResult
nodes.summary: Builds the fromString callback arguments (null, Map) by wrapping the loaded map_ptr in a Napi::External and passing it to the Map constructor.

nodes.name: fromStringSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously validates a stylesheet string and an optional {strict, base} options object, then calls mapnik::load_map_string and rethrows Mapnik errors as JS exceptions.

nodes.name: fromString
nodes.summary: Async Map.fromString that requires a stylesheet string, an options object, and a trailing callback, validates the strict and base options, and queues an AsyncMapFromString worker.

nodes.name: mapnik_map_load.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Map.load and Map.loadSync, which read a Mapnik XML stylesheet from a file path (with optional strict and base options) into the wrapped mapnik::Map; the async form runs through a Napi::AsyncWorker.

nodes.name: AsyncMapLoad
nodes.summary: Napi::AsyncWorker that stores a map_ptr, the stylesheet file path, the base path, and the strict flag so that Map.load can parse the XML file on a background thread.

nodes.name: AsyncMapLoad.Execute
nodes.summary: Runs mapnik::load_map with the stored stylesheet path on the worker thread and records the message of any thrown exception with SetError.

nodes.name: AsyncMapLoad.GetResult
nodes.summary: Returns (null, Map) to the load callback: it wraps the shared map pointer in an External and constructs a new JS Map object from it.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Async Map.load that validates the stylesheet path string, the options object with strict and base keys, and the last-argument callback, then queues an AsyncMapLoad worker and returns undefined.

nodes.name: loadSync
nodes.summary: Loads a stylesheet file into the map on the calling thread: it accepts a path plus at most one options object, validates strict and base, and throws a JS Error when mapnik::load_map fails.

nodes.name: mapnik_map_render.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements Map.render, renderSync, renderFile, and renderFileSync: it parses render options, guards the Map with acquire()/release(), and renders to a mapnik.Image with AGG, to a UTF Grid, to a vector tile through the vector_tile_impl processor, or to an image, PDF, or SVG file.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses std::launch values from <future> as a threading-mode option and a variant visitor (agg_renderer_visitor) that renders only image_rgba8. The non-Cairo branch of renderFileSync references an undeclared `m`, so the file compiles only when HAVE_CAIRO is defined.

nodes.name: agg_renderer_visitor
nodes.summary: Image variant visitor that renders the map with mapnik::agg_renderer into an image_rgba8 with the stored request, variables, scale factor, offsets, and scale denominator, and throws std::runtime_error for any other image type.

nodes.name: AsyncRender
nodes.summary: Base Napi::AsyncWorker for map render jobs that keeps the Map pointer and, in OnWorkComplete, releases the Map in-use flag and drops the reference that the caller took before it queued the job.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderImage
nodes.summary: AsyncRender subclass that renders the map into a JS mapnik.Image (image_ptr) with buffer size, scale, offsets, and variables, then returns a new Image wrapper to the callback.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderImage.Execute
nodes.summary: Builds a mapnik::request from the map width, height, and current extent, sets the buffer size, and applies agg_renderer_visitor to the target image on the worker thread.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderGrid
nodes.summary: AsyncRender subclass that renders one map layer into a mapnik::grid for UTF grid interactivity and returns a new Grid wrapper to the callback.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderGrid.Execute
nodes.summary: Copies the grid field names, removes the internal __id__ key, adds the grid join key, and runs mapnik::grid_renderer on the selected layer index at the given scale denominator.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderFile
nodes.summary: AsyncRender subclass that writes the rendered map directly to an output file, with Cairo for pdf, svg, ps, ARGB32, and RGB24 formats or with AGG and an optional palette for raster formats.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderFile.Execute
nodes.summary: Calls mapnik::save_to_cairo_file when use_cairo is set (or reports that Cairo is not available); otherwise it renders into an image_rgba8 with agg_renderer and saves it with mapnik::save_to_file, with or without a palette.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderVectorTile
nodes.summary: AsyncRender subclass that carries the vector tile encoding options (area threshold, simplify distance, polygon union, fill type, threading mode, image format, scaling method, variables) and fills a merc_tile from the map datasources.

nodes.name: AsyncRenderVectorTile.Execute
nodes.summary: Configures a mapnik::vector_tile_impl::processor with the stored simplification, polygon union, fill type, ring processing, scaling, image format, area threshold, and threading options, then calls update_tile on the target tile.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Async Map.render entry point: it validates the renderable object and callback, parses buffer_size, scale, scale_denominator, and offsets, and dispatches to AsyncRenderImage, AsyncRenderGrid (layer and fields options), or AsyncRenderVectorTile (encoding options and variables); it throws when the Map is already in use.

nodes.name: renderSync
nodes.summary: Renders the map synchronously with AGG into an image_rgba8 and returns an encoded Buffer in the requested format (default png), with optional palette, buffer_size, scale, and scale_denominator options.

nodes.name: renderFile
nodes.summary: Validates an output path, an optional options object (format, palette, buffer_size, scale, scale_denominator, variables), and a callback, guesses the format from the file extension when it is empty, and queues an AsyncRenderFile worker.

nodes.name: renderFileSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously renders the map to a file path: it sends vector formats (pdf, svg, ps, ARGB32, RGB24) to Cairo and raster formats to AGG plus mapnik::save_to_file, and releases the Map lock on success and on error.

nodes.name: mapnik_vector_tile.cpp
nodes.summary: Defines the VectorTile N-API class: Initialize binds about 40 JS methods and accessors that the mapnik_vector_tile_*.cpp files implement, the constructor validates z/x/y and the tile_size/buffer_size options, and the file implements the extent, layer-name, layer extraction, and x/y/z/tileSize/bufferSize accessors.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Registers the JS VectorTile class with x, y, z, tileSize, and bufferSize accessors, the render, data, composite, query, GeoJSON, image, and clear methods, the Boost-gated geometry reports, and the static info method, then sets VectorTile on exports.

nodes.name: VectorTile
nodes.summary: VectorTile constructor that either adopts a merc_tile_ptr passed as a Napi::External or validates non-negative integer z, x, y below 2^z and optional tile_size (default 4096) and buffer_size (default 128) before it creates a new merc_tile.

nodes.name: extent
nodes.summary: Returns the Web Mercator extent of the tile as a JS array [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

nodes.name: bufferedExtent
nodes.summary: Returns the tile extent grown by the buffer size as a [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] JS array, read from merc_tile::get_buffered_extent.

nodes.name: names
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of every layer name that the tile stores, read from merc_tile::get_layers.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Extracts one named layer into a new VectorTile with the same x, y, z, size, and buffer: it scans the protobuf LAYERS messages, copies the matching layer buffer, and throws when the layer does not exist.

nodes.name: emptyLayers
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of the layer names that the tile marks as empty, meaning layers that kept no features after processing.

nodes.name: paintedLayers
nodes.summary: Returns a JS array of the layer names that the tile marks as painted, meaning that the source dataset had features inside the tile.

nodes.name: set_tile_x
nodes.summary: Setter for vt.x that requires a number, rejects negative values with an Error, and then updates the tile column (x) on the merc_tile.

nodes.name: set_tile_y
nodes.summary: Setter for vt.y that throws on a non-number or a negative value and otherwise stores the new tile row (y) on the merc_tile.

nodes.name: set_tile_z
nodes.summary: Setter for vt.z that validates a non-negative number and writes the zoom level to the underlying merc_tile.

nodes.name: set_tile_size
nodes.summary: Setter for vt.tileSize that requires a number greater than zero and updates the tile grid size that encoding uses.

nodes.name: set_buffer_size
nodes.summary: Setter for vt.bufferSize that accepts a negative buffer only while tileSize + 2 * buffer stays positive, then updates the tile buffer size.

nodes.name: mapnik_vector_tile.hpp
nodes.summary: Declares the VectorTile N-API class around a mapnik::vector_tile_impl::merc_tile_ptr, together with the query structs (query_lonlat, query_result, query_hit, queryMany_result) that VectorTile.query and queryMany return.
nodes.languageNotes: The reportGeometry* declarations use the guard BOOST_VERSION >= 105800, but Initialize in mapnik_vector_tile.cpp registers them under BOOST_VERSION >= 105600, so the two guards disagree for Boost 1.56 and 1.57.

nodes.name: VectorTile
nodes.summary: Napi::ObjectWrap class for a Mapbox Vector Tile at z/x/y; it declares the data I/O, render, composite, query, GeoJSON, image, clear, geometry report, and accessor methods that the mapnik_vector_tile_*.cpp files implement.

nodes.name: query_result
nodes.summary: Struct for one query hit: the layer name, the distance, the x/y hit coordinates, and the matched mapnik::feature_ptr, with a constructor that sets the numbers to zero.

nodes.name: mapnik_vector_tile_clear.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements VectorTile.clearSync and VectorTile.clear, which remove all layer data from the tile; clear uses the sync path when it gets no arguments and otherwise runs an AsyncClear worker.

nodes.name: AsyncClear
nodes.summary: Anonymous-namespace Napi::AsyncWorker that holds a merc_tile_ptr and empties the tile on a background thread for VectorTile.clear.

nodes.name: AsyncClear.Execute
nodes.summary: Calls merc_tile::clear on the worker thread and sets a worker error if that call throws, a path that the tests do not cover.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: VectorTile.clear entry point that delegates to clearSync when it gets no arguments, requires the last argument to be a callback, and otherwise queues an AsyncClear worker.

nodes.name: mapnik_vector_tile_composite.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements VectorTile.composite and compositeSync, which merge an array of source VectorTiles into the target tile by re-rendering them through a vector_tile_impl processor with options such as area_threshold, simplify_distance, reencode, max_extent, fill_type, and threading_mode.
nodes.languageNotes: The sync and async entry points duplicate about 250 lines of option parsing, and the two copies differ in small checks: compositeSync requires scale > 0, but composite only rejects scale < 0.

nodes.name: _composite
nodes.summary: Creates a size-by-size EPSG:3857 mapnik::Map whose maximum extent is max_extent or the buffered extent of the target, configures a vector_tile_impl::processor with all composite options, and calls vector_tile_impl::composite to merge the source tiles into the target tile.

nodes.name: compositeSync
nodes.summary: Synchronous VectorTile.compositeSync that validates the tile array and about 15 options (area_threshold, simplify_distance, strictly_simple, fill_type, threading_mode, scale, offsets, reencode, max_extent, image settings), unwraps each source tile, and calls _composite.

nodes.name: AsyncCompositeVectorTile
nodes.summary: Anonymous-namespace Napi::AsyncWorker that copies the target tile, the source tiles, and all composite options, runs _composite on a worker thread, and returns a VectorTile wrapper of the target.

nodes.name: AsyncCompositeVectorTile.Execute
nodes.summary: Worker-thread call of _composite with the stored option fields; any std::exception becomes the error that the composite callback receives.

nodes.name: composite
nodes.summary: Async VectorTile.composite that falls back to compositeSync without a trailing callback, otherwise validates the tile array and options in the same way, and queues an AsyncCompositeVectorTile worker.

nodes.name: mapnik_vector_tile_data.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements raw protobuf I/O for VectorTile: setData/setDataSync replace the tile data, addData/addDataSync merge more data, and getData/getDataSync return the tile bytes as a Buffer with optional gzip compression, level, strategy, and buffer release.

nodes.name: AsyncSetData
